biography.value: Inferno Sovereigns understand that they are fighting. Immolating Presence costs 2 [Combat] actions on arrival to set conditions; the third action that turn goes into a Magma Fist against the nearest priority target. Subsequent turns spend two actions on Magma Fist or Fire Lance and the third on positioning or a second ranged attack at penalty. Conflagration Aura handles anyone who closes without instruction. A Friendly Inferno Sovereign is a force of nature on the summoner's behalf. Even a Cooperative one works efficiently — its intelligence means instructions land without interpretation errors.

system.attacksNotes:
Magma Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage; target gains Burning condition; no save.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage + Burning; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or gains Stunned until end of their next turn.

Fire Lance [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft

  • Margin 1:: 18 fire damage (14 + 4 Dex); target gains Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 18 fire damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Burning; no save.
  • Margin 3: 18 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning; all creatures within 10 feet of target take 8 fire damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Conflagration Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 10 feet take 8 fire damage (Half DR). Flammable objects within 10 feet ignite automatically at the start of each round. Immolating Presence (1/encounter) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases a pulse of fire in a 30-foot diameter. All creatures in range make a Reflex save. Compare Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7 targeting vs. each save.

  • Margin 1:: 20 fire damage + Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning.
  • Margin 3: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning + Blinded until end of their next turn from the searing flash.

Momentum Defense: While the Inferno Sovereign has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Inferno Sovereign fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
